tasks.title: audit of the v0.2.0 races and atomicity fix
acceptance: for every checklist item a verdict OK/NOK with a file:line of the current team.py

checklist: a single state lock on all mutations of tasks.json and the mailbox (claim/verify/message/read/release); a unique tmp file (pid+uuid) in atomic writes; an os.replace retry on PermissionError; reclaiming a stale lock; no live concurrency test of two claims, only a static audit of the code
in a separate block: residual risks (what the lock does NOT protect against)

tasks.title: audit of the v0.2.0 name validation, release and round limit
acceptance: for every checklist item a verdict OK/NOK with a file:line of the current team.py

checklist: NAME_RE validation of team / --by / --to / --for / task ids / assignee at init; release returns a task to pending; verify fail with rounds>=2 moves the task to blocked and writes ROUND LIMIT to the mailbox; claim updates assignee to the actual executor
in a separate block: residual risks

tasks.title: audit of the v0.2.0 documentation and manifest consistency
acceptance: for every checklist item a verdict OK/NOK with a file:line

checklist: the version 0.2.0 in plugin.json and marketplace.json matches; every command from SKILL.md exists in team.py with the same flags; the README section "What is inside" matches the v0.2.0 mechanics (state lock, blocked, release, tokens); the BACKLOG section "Done in v0.2.0" does not promise anything that is not in the code
